_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Complacency with flat funding and only +5% 30d momentum; absent a VIX/momentum/F&G breaker this remains a coil where HOLD is the base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative silent on phase and talks commodities only
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-55 and 30d BTC change stays roughly 0-10% with funding remaining near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 39 with momentum turning negative and VIX factor rising (Anxiety), or F&G and momentum expand through 62 with funding lifting (Disbelief)
